them.en: the STE100 skill makes the agent do
them.zh: STE100 skill 让 agent 做的

steps.en: Install the skill into your project
Paste the text and ask for a rewrite
Picks a mode, then flags violations sentence by sentence, optionally running the linter first
steps.zh: 选好模式，逐句标出违规，可先跑 linter

steps.en: Rewrites only flagged sentences, keeping every fact, condition and hedge
steps.zh: 只改被标出的句子，保住每条事实、条件和确定程度

steps.en: Returns the rewritten text alone, plus a note when it kept a longer phrase
steps.zh: 只返回改好的文字，留了长说法时附一行说明

value.en: Agent-facing English comes back as short one-meaning sentences another agent cannot misparse, with no fact or hedge lost
value.zh: 给 agent 读的英文变成一句一义的短句，下游 agent 读不歪，事实和确定程度一个不丢
